# Media.net
> Media.net is a sell-side platform helping advertisers and publishers achieve programmatic outcomes across every screen.

Media.net provides programmatic advertising solutions for both demand and supply partners, with dedicated pages for advertisers, publishers, and company information.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://www.media.net/): Overview of Media.net’s sell-side platform, outcomes-focused positioning, and partner value proposition.
- [Publishers](https://www.media.net/publishers): Publisher-focused solutions for monetization, revenue growth, and access to demand.
- [Advertisers](https://www.media.net/advertiser): Advertiser-focused solutions for reaching premium inventory and outcome-driven campaigns.
- [About Us](https://www.media.net/aboutus): Company background, mission, and information about Media.net’s business and partnerships.

## Publisher Solutions
- [Publishers](https://www.media.net/publishers): Main publisher solutions page covering monetization and revenue optimization offerings.
- [Home](https://www.media.net/): Highlights exclusive revenue opportunities and industry-best solutions for publishers.
- [About Us](https://www.media.net/aboutus): Context on Media.net’s partnerships, people, and company approach relevant to publishers.

## Advertiser Solutions
- [Advertisers](https://www.media.net/advertiser): Main advertiser page focused on premium inventory access and campaign outcomes.
- [Home](https://www.media.net/): Introduces Media.net’s outcome-first SSP positioning for advertisers across screens.
- [About Us](https://www.media.net/aboutus): Company overview and partnership philosophy relevant to advertising clients.

## Company
- [About Us](https://www.media.net/aboutus): Learn about Media.net’s company story, values, and strategic positioning.
- [Home](https://www.media.net/): High-level introduction to Media.net’s platform and market focus.
- [Publishers](https://www.media.net/publishers): Publisher-facing business area within the company’s platform offering.
- [Advertisers](https://www.media.net/advertiser): Advertiser-facing business area within the company’s platform offering.

## Platform Overview
- [Home](https://www.media.net/): Describes Media.net as an outcome-first SSP for brands and publishers.
- [Advertisers](https://www.media.net/advertiser): Details how advertisers access premium inventory through the platform.
- [Publishers](https://www.media.net/publishers): Details how publishers unlock revenue through Media.net solutions.

## Partnerships
- [Home](https://www.media.net/): Emphasizes intentional partnerships and people as part of Media.net’s approach.
- [Advertisers](https://www.media.net/advertiser): Explains advertiser-side collaboration around premium inventory and outcomes.
- [Publishers](https://www.media.net/publishers): Explains publisher-side collaboration around monetization and revenue growth.
